title: Dyadic predictable Brownian square errors vanish in mean square
source_anchor: Original Samplinglib supplement: Dyadic predictable Brownian square errors vanish in mean square. Exact assumptions and formula below.
target_statement: For the dyadic grids on [0,T], suppose all predictable weights have second moments bounded by one constant C, uniformly over levels and cells. Their compensated weighted square-increment sums tend to zero in mean square.
